-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

list-items.name: list-items
list-items.description: List files and folders inside a OneDrive folder. Defaults to the drive root. Address the folder by itemId or by path.

params.itemId: Folder item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Folder path relative to the drive root, e.g. "Documents/Reports". Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.maxResults: Maximum number of items to return (default: 50, max: 200)

get-item.name: get-item
get-item.description: Get metadata for a single OneDrive file or folder, addressed by itemId or by path.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Item path relative to the drive root, e.g. "Documents/notes.txt". Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

search-items.name: search-items
search-items.description: Search OneDrive for files and folders matching a free-text query.

params.maxResults: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25, max: 200)

download-file.name: download-file
download-file.description: Download a OneDrive file and save it to the local filesystem. Files above 50 MB are refused.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: File path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

get-file-content.name: get-file-content
get-file-content.description: Read the contents of a text-based OneDrive file inline, without saving it to disk. Limited to 1 MB.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: File path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

convert-file.name: convert-file
convert-file.description: Convert a OneDrive document (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other supported types) to PDF and save it locally. Files above 50 MB are refused.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: File path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

upload-file.name: upload-file
upload-file.description: Upload a local file to OneDrive. Files below 4 MB upload directly; larger files use a chunked upload session — a failed chunk aborts the whole upload rather than resuming. Overwrites an existing file with the same name.

params.localPath: Absolute path of the local file to upload
params.destinationPath: Destination folder path relative to the drive root, e.g. "Documents". Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones. Defaults to the root.
params.fileName: Name to store the file under, as a literal name rather than a pre-encoded one. Defaults to the local file name.

create-folder.name: create-folder
create-folder.description: Create a new folder in OneDrive. Address the containing folder with parentId or parentPath; with neither, the folder is created at the drive root.

params.name: Name of the new folder
params.parentId: ID of the folder to create the new folder inside. Takes precedence over parentPath. Defaults to the drive root.
params.parentPath: Path of the folder to create the new folder inside, relative to the drive root, e.g. "Documents/Reports". Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones. Defaults to the drive root.
params.conflictBehavior: What to do if the name exists: "rename" (default), "replace", or "fail".

copy-item.name: copy-item
copy-item.description: Copy a OneDrive file or folder to another folder. Waits for the copy to finish before returning. Specify the item with itemId or path, and the destination with destinationFolderId or destinationPath; with neither destination, the copy is placed at the drive root.

params.itemId: Item ID to copy. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path of the item to copy, relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.destinationFolderId: Destination folder ID. Takes precedence over destinationPath.
params.destinationPath: Destination folder path relative to the drive root. Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones. Omitting both destination arguments copies to the drive root.
params.newName: Optional new name for the copy

move-item.name: move-item
move-item.description: Move a OneDrive file or folder into a different folder. Specify the item with itemId or path, and the destination with destinationFolderId or destinationPath; with neither destination, the item is moved to the drive root.

params.itemId: Item ID to move. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path of the item to move, relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.destinationFolderId: Destination folder ID. Takes precedence over destinationPath.
params.destinationPath: Destination folder path relative to the drive root. Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones. Omitting both destination arguments moves the item to the drive root.

rename-item.name: rename-item
rename-item.description: Rename a OneDrive file or folder without moving it.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.newName: The new name for the item

delete-item.name: delete-item
delete-item.description: Delete a OneDrive file or folder. The item moves to the recycle bin, but this app cannot restore it.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

create-share-link.name: create-share-link
create-share-link.description: Create a sharing link for a OneDrive item, with a chosen permission level and audience.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

invite-people.name: invite-people
invite-people.description: Share a OneDrive item with specific people by email, granting read or write access.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.message: Optional message included in the invitation
params.requireSignIn: Whether recipients must sign in (default: true)
params.sendInvitation: Whether to email the invitation (default: true)

list-permissions.name: list-permissions
list-permissions.description: List everyone and every sharing link that currently has access to a OneDrive item.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

remove-permission.name: remove-permission
remove-permission.description: Revoke a sharing grant or link on a OneDrive item. Use list-permissions to find the permission ID.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

list-shared-with-me.name: list-shared-with-me
list-shared-with-me.description: List OneDrive files and folders that other people have shared with this account. Listing only: a shared item lives on the drive of the person who shared it, and every other tool in this app addresses /me/drive, so the IDs returned here cannot be passed to get-item, download-file, or any other tool. Use webUrl to open a shared item.

params.maxResults: Maximum number of items to return (default: 50, max: 200)

list-recent.name: list-recent
list-recent.description: List OneDrive files this account accessed recently, most recent first.

params.maxResults: Maximum number of items to return (default: 25, max: 200)

get-drive-info.name: get-drive-info
get-drive-info.description: Get information about the OneDrive account, including storage quota and usage.

list-versions.name: list-versions
list-versions.description: List the version history of a OneDrive file. Use this to recover an earlier version after an unwanted overwrite.

params.itemId: Item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Item path relative to the drive root. Pass literal file and folder names, not pre-encoded ones.

name: OneDrive
description: Microsoft OneDrive file management — browse, upload, download, organize, and share files via Microsoft Graph API

changelog.notes: Initial release — browse, upload, download, organize, share, and search OneDrive files
